completion:
For each test that actually occurred, check the sample date against the scheduled sample date.
3. Calculate the variance (scheduled date - actual date) to see how many days late the sample was.
4. For samples taken after the deadline specified in your state's monitoring regulations, report as late samples (see generic guidance on webpage April 11, 2003) late.
5. For samples taken within the interval allowed, report as completed and input analytical results.
